# axm mcps publish

Publish an MCP server

## When to use

Publish an MCP server

## Usage

```bash
axm mcps publish [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description                       |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `name` | string | Yes      | MCP server FQN (@owner/mcps/name) |

## Flags

| Name          | Type    | Required | Description                                                             |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--registry`  | string  | No       | Registry source name                                                    |
| `--scope`     | choice  | No       | Configuration scope: project (default) or user (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y` | boolean | No       | Auto-accept confirmation prompts                                        |
| `--preview`   | boolean | No       | Display plan without applying                                           |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Publish an MCP server**

```bash
axm mcps publish @acme/mcps/context
```

**Preview publishing an MCP server**

```bash
axm mcps publish @acme/mcps/context --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
